```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```


I want to illustrate the mechanism of cross border saturation.
On 2018-01-02, French and Spanish prices are equal and comove perfectly,
until the Cross border capacity is saturated (to about 3000),
then there are separate prices.



```{r}
setwd(file.path(Sys.getenv("REPLICATION_ROOT", "."), "day_ahead/outputs/cross_border"))
price_merge_CBF <- read_parquet( "price_merge_CBF.parquet")

price_merge_CBF <-price_merge_CBF %>% 
  mutate(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES = as.numeric(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES),
         SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR = as.numeric(SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR),
         SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES = as.numeric(SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES),
         SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR = as.numeric(SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR),
        SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES = SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES - SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES ,
         SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR = SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR - SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR,
         price_diff_fr_esp = price_fr - price_esp,
         #contrary to CBF I allow for negative CBF
         # with the convention that ESP to FR is >0
         CBF_DA = SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR - SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES
         )

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_merge_CBF)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_merge_CBF))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "day_ahead_forecast_esp",  "unpredicted_renewables_esp", "intraday_update_renewables_esp",
  "day_ahead_forecast_fr",  "unpredicted_renewables_fr", "intraday_update_renewables_fr")

price_merge_CBF[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_merge_CBF[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))

price_merge_CBF$weekday <- weekdays(price_merge_CBF$delivery_date)


```



```{r}
plot_example <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  filter(delivery_date == "2019-01-02" | delivery_date =="2019-01-03")

plot_NTC_fr_esp <-  ggplot(data = plot_example, aes(x = datetime))+
  geom_line(aes(y = price_fr*20, color = "FR"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = price_esp*20, color = "ES"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = NTC_ESP_FR, color = "ES -> FR"), linetype ="dashed")+
  geom_line(aes(y = NTC_FR_ESP, color = "FR -> ES"), linetype ="dashed")+
  geom_line(aes(y = SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR, color = "ES -> FR"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES, color = "FR -> ES"))+
    # Mise en place de l'échelle secondaire pour les prix
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "NTC & Exchanges",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 20, name = "Price (€/MWh)") # Ajuste l'échelle inverse
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 15),      # taille du texte
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),     # taille du titre
        legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm") ,          # taille des symboles/rectangles,
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe x
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # taille et rotation des ticks x
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)    # taille des ticks y
  )

plot_NTC_fr_esp
```

Faire apparaître le seuil de saturation




```{r}
library(latex2exp)
price_merge_CBF <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
       mutate(
         Taux_Sat_ES_FR = SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR/NTC_ESP_FR,
         Taux_Sat_FR_ES = SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES/NTC_FR_ESP) %>% 
  filter(Taux_Sat_FR_ES<1.1 & Taux_Sat_ES_FR<1.1) %>%
  mutate(
         saturation_bin_ES_FR = ntile(Taux_Sat_ES_FR, 100),
         saturation_bin_FR_ES = ntile(Taux_Sat_FR_ES, 100)
       )

plot_data_ES_FR <- price_merge_CBF %>%
  group_by(saturation_bin_ES_FR) %>%
  summarize(
    taux_saturation_moyen = mean(SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR/NTC_ESP_FR, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_diff_moyen = mean(price_diff_fr_esp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  filter(price_diff_moyen >=0)

plot_data_FR_ES <- price_merge_CBF %>%
  group_by(saturation_bin_FR_ES) %>%
  summarize(
    taux_saturation_moyen = -mean(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES/NTC_FR_ESP, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_diff_moyen = mean(price_diff_fr_esp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  filter(price_diff_moyen <=0)

ggplot() +
geom_point(data =plot_data_ES_FR, aes(x = taux_saturation_moyen, y = price_diff_moyen, color = "ES -> FR")) +
  geom_point(data =plot_data_FR_ES, aes(x = taux_saturation_moyen, y = price_diff_moyen, color = "FR -> ES")) +
labs(x = "Taux de saturation", y = TeX('$\\Delta p$')) +
theme_minimal()
```


```{r}

plot_data_CBF <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  filter(gen_tot_fr > 25000) %>% 
  na.omit()


m_reg <- lm(price_fr ~ Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr +
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr + 
     day_ahead_forecast_fr+ unpredicted_renewables_fr +intraday_update_renewables_fr + spot_gas_esp+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
   data = plot_data_CBF)

plot_data_CBF$price_res <- residuals(m_reg)

plot_data_FR <- plot_data_CBF %>%
  mutate(saturation = (price_diff_fr_esp != 0),
         generation_bin_FR = ntile(gen_tot_fr, 100)
       )  %>%
group_by(generation_bin_FR, saturation) %>%
  summarize(
    price_moyen = mean(price_fr, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_res = mean(price_res, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 
plot_data_ES <- plot_data_CBF %>%
  mutate(saturation = (price_diff_fr_esp != 0),
         generation_bin_ES = ntile(gen_tot_esp, 100)
       )  %>%
group_by(generation_bin_ES, saturation) %>%
  summarize(
    price_moyen = mean(price_esp, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_res = mean(price_res, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
         
ggplot()+
  geom_line(data = plot_data_FR, aes(x = generation_bin_FR, y = price_res, color = "FR", linetype  = as.factor(saturation)))+
  geom_line(data = plot_data_ES, aes(x = generation_bin_ES, y = price_res, color = "ES", linetype  = as.factor(saturation)))+
  labs(title = "Residuals of the regression model", x = "Generation bin", y = "Price residuals")+
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
plot_data_FR <- plot_data_CBF %>%
   mutate(generation_bin_FR = ntile(gen_tot_fr, 100),
          crossborder = case_when(
    Taux_Sat_FR_ES > 0.9 ~ "Saturated FR -> ES",
    Taux_Sat_ES_FR > 0.9 ~ "Saturated ES -> FR",
    (Taux_Sat_ES_FR <0.1) & (Taux_Sat_FR_ES <0.1) ~ "Unused",
    TRUE ~ "Used"
     )) %>% 
group_by(generation_bin_FR, crossborder) %>%
  summarize(
    price_moyen = mean(price_fr, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_res = mean(price_res, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 


ggplot()+
  geom_line(data = plot_data_FR, aes(x = generation_bin_FR, y = price_res, color =  crossborder))+
  # geom_line(data = plot_data_ES, aes(x = generation_bin_ES, y = price_res, color = "ES", linetype  = as.factor(saturation)))+
  labs(title = "Residuals of the regression model", x = "Generation bin", y = "Price residuals")+
  theme_minimal()

```


Cette représentation laisse entendre que chaque point représente autant de points de données.
Donc, que la situation de saturation apparaît autant lorsque la demande est très grande ou très faible.




Illustration de l'exception ibérique

```{r}
exception_start_date <- as.POSIXct("15-06-2022 00:00:00", 
                             format = "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S", tz= "Europe/Brussels")
exception_end_date <- as.POSIXct("01-03-2023 00:00:00", 
                                   format = "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S", tz= "Europe/Brussels")
#exclure une valeur aberrante qui rend le graphique moins lisible

plot_data <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  filter(price_fr < 1500)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(plot_data)+
  geom_line(aes(x=datetime, y=price_fr, color = "France")) +
  geom_line(aes(x=datetime, y=price_esp, color = "Espagne")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = exception_start_date, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = exception_end_date, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Day-ahead electricity prices in France and Spain",
       x = "Date", y = "Price (€/MWh)") +
  theme_minimal()


```
